aluminum_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtas.name: Aluminum bulk minimisation for Surface Energy
aluminum_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtas.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of Aluminum, based on the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. As the final output, report the total energy of the relaxed structure in electronvolts (eV), and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
aluminum_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtas.submission_format: {"BULK ENERGY": <numerical_value without units>, "Relaxed Bulk Structure_path": "<absolute_path>"} eg. {"BULK ENERGY": 56.00, "Relaxed Bulk Structure_path": /structure/structure.data}

silicon_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtask.name: Silicon bulk minimisation for Surface Energy
silicon_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtask.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible Silicon structure file and a ReaxFF potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of Silicon based on given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in kcal/mol, and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
silicon_bulk_energy_minimisation_subtask.submission_format: {"BULK ENERGY": <numerical_value without units>, "Relaxed Bulk Structure_path": "<absolute_path>"} eg. {"BULK ENERGY": 56.00, "Relaxed Bulk Structure_path": /structure/structure.data}

aluminum_slab_energy_minimisation_subtas.name: Aluminum Slab Relaxation for Surface Energy
aluminum_slab_energy_minimisation_subtas.description: Given paths to a LAMMPS-compatible Aluminum structure file and an Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file suitable for molecular dynamics simulations, create a slab in the specified Miller index direction by removing periodic boundary conditions along that direction. Perform a structure relaxation on the slab using the given simulation parameters, replicating the unit cell 5 times along the x, y, and z directions. As the final output, report the total energy of the relaxed slab structure in electronvolts (eV), and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
aluminum_slab_energy_minimisation_subtas.submission_format: {"SLAB ENERGY": <numerical_value without units>, "Relaxed SLAB Structure_path": "<absolute_path>"} eg. {"SLAB ENERGY": 56.00, "Relaxed SLAB Structure_path": /structure/structure.dat}

Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. aluminum_subtask_sa.name: Aluminum Surface Energy Calculation
aluminum_subtask_sa.description: Given the path to LAMMPS-compatible relaxed bulk and slab structures of Aluminum, and the total energies (in electronvolts) of its relaxed bulk and slab configurations, compute the surface energy of Aluminum. Return the surface energy in eV/Å².
